captures.description: THE JOURNAL, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The Electronic Book Review (ebr) is an open-access, peer-reviewed scholarly journal focused on digital textuality, cyberculture, and the intersection of literature, technology, and the arts.' Key details: 'Established in 1995 by Joseph Tabbi and Mark Amerika', its topics ('critical writing, electronic literature, digital humanities, and peer-to-peer scholarly review alternatives'); format ('dynamic web architectures rather than static issues') and support ('several academic institutions and the Electronic Literature Organization'); an offer on recent essays or submitting. Four cards: the journal's site, Wikipedia, Open Humanities Press, the Electronic Literature Directory.
